_comment: Databricks Workflow definition for Daily Orders Pipeline.
Migrated from: scripts/run_daily_orders.ksh
Original trigger: AutoSys job JOB_DAILY_ORDERS_LOAD
Ab Initio -> Databricks Mapping:
run_daily_orders.ksh           -> This workflow JSON definition
AutoSys JOB_DAILY_ORDERS_LOAD  -> Databricks cron schedule (daily 02:00 UTC)
air sandbox run (4 phases)     -> 4 notebook tasks with linear dependencies
PSET parameters                -> job_parameters (resolved at runtime)
setenv.ksh environment vars    -> Databricks job-level parameters
${LOG_DIR}/run.log             -> Databricks driver logs + task values
exit $RC (error propagation)   -> Task dependency on_failure behavior
name: daily_orders_pipeline
description: Daily orders batch pipeline — extract, CDC, staging, production. Migrated from Ab Initio KornShell orchestration (run_daily_orders.ksh).

schedule._comment: Daily at 02:00 UTC. Set to PAUSED for initial deployment — enable after validation.

job_parameters.name: staging_table
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET TARGET_TABLE in orders_staging.pset

job_parameters.name: partition_count
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET PARTITION_COUNT / AI_DEFAULT_PARTITIONS in setenv.ksh

job_parameters.name: batch_size
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET BATCH_SIZE in orders_pipeline.pset

job_parameters.name: max_errors
job_parameters._comment: Equivalent to PSET MAX_ERRORS / AI_MAX_ERRORS in setenv.ksh

_comment: Phase 1: Source extraction.
Ab Initio equivalent: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/extract_orders.mp
Uses parallel_loader notebook with append mode for raw extraction.
tasks.description: Phase 1: Extract orders from source systems into bronze layer

_comment: Phase 2: CDC detection.
Ab Initio equivalent: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/cdc_orders.mp -partition 4
Uses cdc_processor notebook with Delta Lake MERGE.
Phase 3: Staging load.
Ab Initio equivalent: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/load_staging_orders.mp
Validates and promotes data from bronze to staging (silver) layer.
tasks.description: Phase 3: Validate and promote to staging (silver) layer

_comment: Phase 4: Production load.
Ab Initio equivalent: air sandbox run ${GRAPH_DIR}/prod_rollover_orders.mp
Final promotion from silver to gold/production layer.
tasks.description: Phase 4: Production rollover — promote to gold layer

job_clusters._comment: Shared cluster for all tasks. Sized to match Ab Initio's 4-partition default.

email_notifications._comment: Replaces Slack webhook alerts from Ab Initio JobMonitor._send_alert()

on_failure._comment: Configure Slack/PagerDuty webhook ID for failure alerts

rules._comment: Alert if pipeline takes >90 minutes (SLA breach detection)
